_schema: Entries are summary-only Knowledge Items. The 'file' field is omitted once the raw log has been purged (agents.md §4 definitive_amnesia) — the 1-line summary IS the retained knowledge.

items.summary: The .agents pre-commit hook's audit_secret_shielding() BLOCKS (exit 2, not a warning) on bare keyword-then-equals-sign substrings for password/secret/API-key/private-key style names, case-insensitively with no context, scanning the full staged blob (not just the diff) — it false-positives on ordinary variable names or $VAR-templated example config in any Django settings.py, AND on this very memory file whenever an entry has to describe the bug using the trigger wording, forcing paraphrase to get memory_index.json committed at all. Framework-class (affects every host with normal Django/config code), not host-specific — a nucleus fix proposal was flagged to the human but not yet drafted/submitted upstream.

This host's sessions ran directly on main (no ai-sprint/[ID] branch, no formal Sprint ever opened) — every git push origin main attempt via Claude Code's own Bash tool is blocked by the on_commit.py PreToolUse hook (RA-12), regardless of git flags like --no-verify, because it intercepts at the Claude Code tool-call layer, not git's. The fix is never to retry the push in-session — hand the exact command to the human to run in their own terminal, then verify with git fetch afterward.

When introducing a new opt-in _parse_strict_bool-gated Django setting, it must be added to .github/workflows/ci.yml's env blocks (both lint-and-test and deploy-check) in the same commit — CROSS_SITE_FRONTEND was missed in dd8c9b3 despite TRUST_PROXY_SSL_HEADER (added in the same commit) getting it right, breaking CI on every push until hotfix H-001-CI. Host-class: check ci.yml env blocks whenever settings.py gains a new _parse_strict_bool() call.

A Dependabot bump of a config-loading library (envtoml, dj-database-url) can break Django boot entirely via an API-contract change invisible in that library's own changelog scope — envtoml 0.4.0 required binary-mode file handles, breaking settings.py's text-mode open() until hotfix H-002-Backend. Manually run manage.py check with the new pinned version before merging any such bump; a green CI isn't sufficient proof since CI can independently be red for an unrelated reason (as it was for H-001-CI at the same time).
